newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Spescom interim shr jumps, no div.
newsitem.headline: Spescom interim shr jumps, no div.

text.p: NOTE - Spescom said no dividend would be declared in the interim period and in future one dividend would be declared at the financial year end.

The company said it expected second half results to be better than the first half and full year performance to be significantly up on the previous year. Spescom said that several new business alliances were in the process of being concluded which would impact directly on its Telecommunications, Test & Measurement and Broadcast & Presentation Systems divisions.

Spescom said it would continue to develop and acquire new innovative products and remain on line to introduce several innovations in the area of electricity conservation and wireless loop communications for disadvantaged communities.
It added that all these prospects had significant international potential.
